title: Grandpa Pig's Boat
hook: 爷爷和狗爷爷开船比赛，谁也不肯让谁，最后一条船没油了，被另一条拖回家。

cells.q: What must they wear on the boat?
cells.a: They must wear life-jackets when they are on the boat.

cells.q: What is Grandpa Pig on the boat?
cells.a: He is the captain, and he never says anything silly.
cells.cn: 他是船长，从来不说傻话。

cells.q: What did Peppa ask Grandpa Pig?
cells.a: She asked him to go a little slower on the river.
He is Grandpa Pig's very best friend.
cells.cn: 他是猪爷爷最好的朋友。

cells.q: What did Granny Pig say to them?
cells.a: She said the two of them are acting like little children.
cells.cn: 她说他们两个像小孩子一样。

cells.q: What did Granny Pig remind Grandpa Pig?
cells.a: She reminded him that Granddad Dog is his best friend.
cells.cn: 她提醒他狗爷爷可是他最好的朋友。

cells.q: What happened to Grandpa Pig's boat?
cells.a: He says he wins, but his boat runs out of petrol.
cells.cn: 他说自己赢了，可船却没油了。

cells.q: What did Granny Pig ask the two grandpas?
cells.a: She asked if the two of them will ever grow up.
cells.cn: 她问这两个爷爷什么时候才能长大。

cells.q: What did Granddad Dog do at the end?
cells.a: He towed Grandpa Pig's boat all the way home.
cells.cn: 他把猪爷爷的船一路拖回了家。
